sections.overview:
1. 整体市场概况和情绪

今日主要事件：

  • The Strait of Hormuz was "closed" again, but authenticity is in doubt: Iran's armed forces announced on Saturday (6/20) that due to Israel's continued airstrikes on Lebanon and the U.S./Israel violating the ceasefire MOU, it would again blockade the Strait, only 3 days after reopening it. But the U.S. publicly contradicted this — Vance said the Strait remained open, and U.S. Central Command said 55 merchant ships passed through on Saturday, carrying more than 17 million barrels of crude oil. The community has fully turned this "open-close-open" cycle into an arbitrage meme ("snip snap"). This happened after the weekend market close and has not yet been priced in; it is Monday's biggest variable.
  • First round of U.S.-Iran talks in Switzerland postponed/canceled: The White House said Vance canceled his trip to Switzerland due to "unresolved logistical issues"; Iran insists that Article 13 of the MOU must first be implemented (Israel's permanent withdrawal from Lebanon and the unfreezing of up to $100 billion in funds) before talks can proceed. Vance said dialogue could still happen on Sunday (5:30pm ET). Controversy over the $300 billion "reconstruction investment fund" continues to escalate, with the community mocking it as a "surrender agreement."
  • Memory/semiconductors exploded higher in the most recent trading session (Thursday 6/18 close): MU +9.19% to $1139.94, SNDK +12.48% to $2204.79, INTC +10.56% to $133.86, TSM +6.95%, MRVL +7.82%, AMD +4.76%, AVGO +4.85%, WDC +5.64%; QQQ +2.49% to $740.48, SPY +1.00% to $748.46, IWM +1.94%. Note that DIA was instead -0.14%, showing extreme divergence: "AI/semis going vertical while the Dow and software lag."
  • MU earnings scheduled for after the close on 6/24, revered by the community as "the most important earnings report of the year." Market expectations for next-quarter revenue guidance are around $39.6–41.0 billion. MU is already up 244% YTD and has surpassed $1 trillion in market cap. Options imply a move of about ±$140.
  • Lagging sectors: MSFT was almost flat on Thursday ($379.08), continuing to be mocked as "never closing green"; SPCX -4.16%, MSTR -3.57%, ASTS -6.18%, DELL -2.41%, PLTR -1.71%.

社区氛围：周末休市加上六一长假，90%的帖子都是拉屎和“开赌场”提币哀嚎，真实交易信号稀少；但潜在的基调是，对内存/人工智能半导体的狂热信心依然完好，伴随着顶级意识，而多头嘲笑空头“每个周末都幻想崩盘，结果在周一开盘时被绿色击垮”。

恐惧/贪婪：贪婪倾向（大约 70/100）。半导体FOMO激烈，“all-in DRAM”成为口号；然而，围绕“财报崩盘后逢低买入”和“周末现金”的防御性共识也在上升，表明极度焦虑与贪婪交织在一起。

情绪与实际市场行为：社区空头利用市场休市来发泄情绪，而最近的实际交易日（周四）是半导体的主要反弹，造成情绪与价格行为之间明显的不匹配。多头嘲笑空头只敢在收盘时发表强硬言论。需要注意的是：周四的反弹尚未消化周六海峡再次受阻的新利空发展，周一的实际开盘方向尚未发生；任何“星期一必须是绿色/红色”的说法都是社区的赌注，而不是事实。
